name: Sin with Me
source:
Lawless luxury is the game to play in Las Vegas. But it's not until you meet the "Night of Sin" circus troupe that you're tempted by every vice the city has to offer. You quickly discover stage lights are hiding more than just sins when their debauchery turns deadly and you must decide if indulging your desire is worth the danger.

[From in-game description]
